name: 扎希尔
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_五_七城的年月.md:5486
who: Zahir, a fire-horn demon-kin who lives on the great canal of wells under the black-grain plain and goes down the shafts with the white-bone diggers; his name set in the third night at the bottom of a shaft when he was forty-eight, and he has looked about thirty ever since. About 193 cm, a deep chest and thick back with a narrow, tight waist; dark red flame patterns run down both arms like banked embers. Skin of a warm reddish fire-horn hue. Close-cropped red-gold hair, bright clear yellow eyes. Of his long black-red horns only two short charred black stumps remain. A small clay cup with one chipped rim hangs from his old leather belt; inside it rides a tiny bone-carved dragon with very small wings. No jewellery. A warm, frank, easy-laughing air; his laugh is low, like two drumbeats through a well wall.
build: 193 cm, tall and powerful: a deep chest, a thick back and heavy shoulders, a tight narrow waist, long strong arms marked with dark red flame patterns.
palette: ember red-gold, charred black, bright yellow, fireproof slate leather, kiln-clay orange
casual: At the canal wells: a broad-shouldered sleeveless fireproof vest of thick slate-dark leather, open at the throat, the arms bare to show the dark red flame patterns; dark canvas trousers tucked into heavy hobnailed boots; the old leather belt with the small chipped clay cup hanging from it. A coil of knotted descent rope over one shoulder. He grins at the viewer, one thumb hooked in the belt.
private: Firing clay for the canal children: a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves pushed up, a kiln-scorched leather apron, canvas trousers and soft boots. In one hand he holds up a small glazed clay horn made for a child to wear on the forehead, laughing.
battle: Going down into the molten cave, in a legend's fireproof war gear kept plain by choice: a broad-shouldered sleeveless vest of mountain-copper scales sewn on black salamander leather, its seams glowing like cooling lava; heat-runed black iron vambraces that glow orange at the wrists; a wide fireproof belt with the small chipped clay cup tied fast to it; heavy iron-shod boots. No weapon. Between the two charred horn stumps a great crown of red-gold flame branches stands up and spreads wide, its edge pushing outward like a shield of fire; the dark red flame patterns on both arms burn bright gold, both open hands thrust forward as if holding back a wall of molten rock.
formal: The day the canal ran through to its last well: a clean dark red long coat of the western cut, closing down the front with bronze buttons, fitted sleeves, a black sash, dark trousers and polished boots; the old belt with the chipped clay cup worn over the coat anyway. He stands straight with a cup of fresh snow-water raised in one hand, a quiet smile.
art: A low-angle portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the bright yellow eyes looking straight at the viewer, a low warm laugh just past. Molten gold-red light from below as from an opened lava cave, deep blue-black shadow above. Foreground blur: a chipped clay cup, a tiny bone dragon, drifting sparks and shards of black glass.
gear: 传奇（约935年踏进，撼世）｜贫（渠上挖井的）｜不靠装备，朴素｜5档｜838年名字凝住，约935年踏进传奇，伟业撼世那一档。他凭角上和心口的火，不拿兵器；档照传奇给顶上的耐火料子（山铜鳞的火蜥皮背心），样子照旧是渠上那一件宽肩背心，不加装饰，那只缺口的陶杯照挂。

About 172 cm, spare and slightly stooped. Thinning straw-pale hair, white at the temples, combed straight back. Mild blue-green eyes that wait for an answer. A long, patient, lined face, clean-shaven. The middle finger of his right hand stained dark with ink. No glasses, no rings. A slow, courteous, tireless air; he asks one question at a time, says you to everyone, and does not judge a line no one will own.

art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the blue-green eyes lifted toward a crowded hall, the mouth closed, about to ask a question. Late gold daylight from a high window on one side, cool shadow on the other. Foreground blur: the edge of an open law book, a quill and a bench rail.

name: 格萝·熊歌
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_五_七城的年月.md:6103
who: Gro Bearsong, a human storyteller of Whalebone Hall north of the White Mother pass, grandmother of Svala, who has told stories on the ice for sixty years; seventy-six in 838. About 158 cm now, her back bent, a stout birch walking stick in one hand. Long white hair in one thick braid down her back. Deep fjord-blue eyes like her granddaughter's, and the same white eyelashes of the Bearsong women, rimed with frost. A round, deeply wrinkled, wind-reddened face. No jewellery. A bright, lively, teasing air; her voice is still clear, and when she tells of bears she stamps the stick twice on the ice and walks like one.
face: FACE, as in the references: a round old woman's face of about seventy-six, NOT young: deep fjord-blue eyes, bright and teasing, with white lashes rimed with frost, deep wrinkles at their corners and across the brow; wind-reddened round cheeks and nose; a lively closed mouth about to speak. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: about 158 cm, small and stout, the back bent.
palette: northern white wool, wolf grey, bear brown, fjord blue, old red
casual: A northern hall elder's clothes: a long white wool outer robe to the ankles with the Bearsong bear embroidered at the hem, head raised and breathing out white mist; a grey wolf-skin coat worn fur inside, the leather side dressed white; an old red wool skirt showing at the hem; fur-lined boots; a knitted cap. She leans on the birch stick with one hand and raises the other like a paw, mid-story.
private: By the hall fire: a long-sleeved red wool dress, a thick grey shawl, the braid over one shoulder, soft fur slippers; she holds a horn cup of warm milk in both hands.
battle_pose: 3) the storytelling outfit: stooped on the birch stick, stamping it on the ice, the other hand raised like a bear's paw, the mouth closed in a sly grin; she does not fight.
battle: On the ice in the long night, in her storyteller's clothes and one heirloom: the white outer robe with the bear at the hem, the wolf-skin coat, the red skirt and fur boots; an old frost-runed bear-claw charm on a cord at her neck that glows faint white in the cold. She leans on the birch stick.
formal: At the midwinter gathering: a long white wool robe embroidered from hem to chest with the Bearsong bear and white mist, a red wool sash, a short white fur cape, her braid bound with a red cord. She stands as straight as her back allows on the stick, a proud, bright look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the fjord-blue eyes glinting under frosted white lashes, a sly storyteller's smile with the mouth closed. Warm hall firelight from one side, cold blue ice light on the other. Foreground blur: a birch stick, drifting snow and a bear-claw charm.
gear: 启源（估）｜中（北境长厅人家）｜不打仗｜1档｜七十六岁的讲故事的老人，不出手。只给她脖子上一枚北境人家传的霜纹熊爪护符。

name: 鲸骨厅的厅主
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_五_七城的年月.md:6103
who: The hall-master of Whalebone Hall north of the White Mother pass, Svala's uncle, who decides whether the door opens; a little past fifty in 838. About 186 cm, big, broad and heavy-limbed, a northern hunter's frame. Pale gold hair going grey, worn long and tied back, and a full pale gold beard in two braids. Deep fjord-blue eyes like his niece's, and the Bearsong family's white eyelashes. A wind-burned, weathered face. A single whalebone bead woven into the left braid of his beard. A taciturn, heavy, steady air; he speaks little, and every word decides something.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad northern man's face a little past fifty, NOT young: deep fjord-blue eyes under heavy pale brows, white eyelashes, lines at the eyes and across the brow, a wind-reddened face, a full pale gold beard going grey, worn in two braids; a closed, taciturn mouth. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: about 186 cm, big, broad and heavy-limbed.
palette: northern white wool, wolf grey, whalebone ivory, fjord blue, iron
casual: A northern hall-master's clothes: a long white wool coat to the shins embroidered at the breast with the Bearsong bear, closing down the front with whalebone toggles, a grey wolf-skin cloak fur outward over the shoulders, a broad belt with a long knife, wool trousers and fur-lined boots. He stands with both hands resting on the head of a long whaling spear set upright, a heavy, silent look.
private: By the hall fire: a long-sleeved undyed wool tunic, wool trousers and soft boots, the cloak off; he holds a horn cup in one big hand.
battle: At the hall door in the long night, in the northern war gear of a hall-master: a long coat of frost-patterned iron scale, the scales etched with fine white rime runes that breathe a faint cold mist, belted over the white wool coat; the wolf-skin cloak fur outward; rune-etched iron bracers. He holds a long whaling spear with a barbed iron head lowered in both hands, a heavy, unmoving look.
formal: At the midwinter gathering of the three halls: a long white wool robe with the Bearsong bear embroidered large across the chest, a wide red sash, a white bearskin mantle on the shoulders, the beard braids bound with whalebone. He stands straight, the hands resting on the spear, grave.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the fjord-blue eyes looking at the viewer as if weighing whether to open the door, the mouth closed. Warm hall firelight from one side, cold blue snow light on the other. Foreground blur: a whalebone door handle and drifting snow.
gear: 灵格（估）｜中（北境长厅）｜照常｜2档｜原页没写位阶，照北境一座长厅的厅主估作灵格，家境中等，给一套北境的霜纹鳞甲和捕鲸长枪。
